notes.surface_finish: As-printed, NOT etched — and that follows from the mandatory production ORDER, not from a finish spec: 01_02 1.3 fixes print+HIP -> hot press-fit assembly Ti/PEEK/Ti -> EAAE -> dehydrogenation bake -> functionalisation, so this surface is already inside the PEEK joint when the anchor is etched. The dual-scale Sa/Sv requirement of 01_02 1.2 is for the gyroid wall and does NOT apply here. Barb downface is self-supporting at about 60 deg from horizontal, Sa about 15 um as-printed - that figure is 01_01 4.3, which cites 01_02 1.6 only for the tip-down orientation that makes it hold. (The consequence is ours; the ORDER is canon.) ATTENTION - this is a CONSEQUENCE, not an instruction, and canon protects every other un-etched surface by an EXPLICIT MASKING line instead (01_02 1.3 Step 7 masks two faces; 02_02 1.2 masks the whole anchor bar the bus terminus), while 01_02 1.3 Step 4 claims the etch reaches the WHOLE surface uniformly. So if this part is etched BEFORE assembly, or if the joint is not a reliable mask, a masking line is needed and none exists yet (00_07 HW.1).
notes.coating_restriction: NOT SPECIFIED, and deliberately so: the 01_02 3.6 map has a row for the Zone-1 gyroid wall and a row for the callus-contact periphery, and this press-fit shank is on NEITHER. Apply nothing without a verdict. The reason is not DET here but FIT: any coating of thickness t adds 2t of DIAMETRAL interference; 01_01 4.2 gives the class and defers the numbers, and the band itself is the Lame-computed 5-34 um in tools/in_silico/lib/constants.py
